title: フィットネス用ランニングマシン
description: 体育施設・ホテルジム向けのランニングマシン外観。固定した走行ベルト、側部ステップと滑り止め条、後ローラーと調整ねじ、モーターカバー、手すり、無表示コンソール・キー外装を造形。ベルト移動・走行・傾斜制御・緊急停止や運動計測は実装していません。安全・身体適合性や実機性能は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.850 × 1.413 × 1.935 m、8,240三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A treadmill exterior for civic fitness facilities and hotel gyms, with static belt, side steps and traction strips, rear roller/adjusters, motor cover, handrails, inactive console and key exterior. Belt travel, running, incline control, emergency-stop behavior and exercise measurement are not implemented. Safety, body fit and equipment performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.850 × 1.413 × 1.935 m; 8,240 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
